build_NSPPARSER: build a python module using NSPQuerier to convert natural language chat commands into logical form action dictionaries
create_MOCKNSPQUERIER: create a MockNSPQuerier instance that returns a dummy GET_MEMORY dialogue tree for any chat input
test_get_logical_form: test the NSPQuerier get_logical_form method by passing a chat string and a parsing model to get a logical form dict
review_validate_parse_tree: review the NSPQuerier validate_parse_tree method to check if a logical form dict conforms to the grammar schema
run_perceive: run the NSPQuerier perceive method to process incoming agent chats and return parsed logical forms
